arStrings.szText: Every {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} seconds, gain a charge of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. Whenever you attack while having an {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} charge, your Ultimate Skills deal {c_number}[{SF_1}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_4}|%x|]{/c}.
Ultimate Skills are dealing increased damage.
